_about: Everlife World Deck v1 (2026-11-05). Extracted from the Restora-Z 2nd batch (2026-10-29, 235 ads, the team's diversity bar). A WORLD is the visual universe an ad lives in: not a layout, not a theme. Every product translates a world to its own category. Dealt per slot by core/scripts/deal_worlds.py; cards rendered in WORLDS.md. Rules (claims, zones, proof, safe area) live in the gates + code, never here.

families.PRINT: paper and print objects: newspapers, tickets, memos, posters, books
families.COMIC: illustrated and stylised worlds: comic, pop art, clay, pixel, knit, stained glass
families.MATERIAL: one material carries the whole ad: marble, glass, liquid, clouds, chrome, feathers
families.SCENE: a real place with real light: bus shelter, pharmacy, porch, gallery, elevator
families.UI: screens and interfaces: phone article, search bar, forecast, notes, switch, waveform
families.PERSON: a real person leads: holdout, hug, UGC selfie, lamp reader, b/w portrait
families.TYPE: typography is the picture: brutalist, swiss, knockout, type ring, scribble, repeat
families.INFOGRAPHIC: the formula explained visually: exploded view, blueprint, numbered, orbit, podium
families.SURREAL: impossible but photoreal: moon, cloud bank, capsule sofa, dreamcore hall, levitation
families.METAPHOR: one clever object idea: yarn, switch, ticket, hourglass, lineup, mini-bed
